ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Tread reads the pedometer to work out your cadence, in steps per minute.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Tread sends your runs straight to your new phone over your Wi-Fi, without going through the internet.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tread reads the code shown on your old phone to bring your runs across.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Tread uses your location to draw your route and measure your distance.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Tread needs your location even with the screen locked, so it keeps recording while your phone is in your pocket.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Tread needs your location even with the screen locked, so it keeps recording while your phone is in your pocket.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Tread reads your weight to estimate calories burned, and your heart rate to show it with your runs.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Tread saves your runs, their distance and their route to Apple Health.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Tread adds the photos you pick to your runs.
